parents.course: Art-Centered Learning at the Secondary Level

ns2:section.sectionText: ARTE 302 is a practicum course with a variable schedule in local secondary schools. Seminar will be held on Tuesday mornings. Students will be observing/teaching in public schools on Thursday mornings. Keep your Tuesday and Thursday mornings open from 8am -12. [No classes before. No classes immediately after.]
